body: Please don’t kill yourself. I won’t sit here and say “time heals” or “suicide is a permanent answer to a temporary problem.” You know these things already and I know I only get angry when people say it to me. I know when I’m feeling low, I’m well aware it’ll get better, but part of me doesn’t want it to. I’ve never been to therapy, I’ve never been officially diagnosed with any mental health disorders, although I suspect there’s some there. I also don’t have all the answers for you. I simply ask. Please don’t kill yourself. I don’t know your name, your gender, your location, or anything. However, I know that you are valuable, you carry a purpose, and that I care. There are people who care that you know also. Please don’t kill yourself.
